choices.content: Drawing 2 balls simultaneously from a bag.
Drawing 1 ball, recording its color, replacing it, and then drawing another.
Returning the ball to the bag and mixing thoroughly after every draw.
Drawing balls twice in succession, with the same number of balls in the bag before each draw.

question.prompt: Which of the following situations involves drawing balls without replacement?

solutions.explanation: Drawing 2 balls simultaneously is equivalent to drawing the first ball without replacing it before drawing the second. B, C, and D all involve replacement.
solutions.title: Recognize drawing without replacement
